'''Abregado-rae''' was a major manufacturing and trade-oriented [[Planet/Legends|planet]], the third of five worlds in the [[Abregado system/Legends|Abregado system]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Gados]] and the [[Moocher]]s. It sat at the beginning of the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]], and was also the starting point for the [[Shapani Bypass/Legends|Shapani Bypass]] or the "Bacta Run". The planet had a reputation as one of the Core Worlds' more rough-and-tumble worlds. It was home to the infamous [[Abregado-rae Spaceport]].

==Description==
[[File:AbregadoRae1319.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The water canals of Abregado-rae Spaceport]]
Despite Abregado-rae's [[Temperature/Legends|temperate]] climate, there was a very limited number of native [[Species/Legends|species]] present, with less than ten species of large animals native to the planet. These included two species of sentient beings: the tall, lanky [[Gados]], which formed the majority of planet's native population, and small, low-intelligent [[Moocher]]s (said to be related to the [[Atzerrian Meek]]s).

Unlike most Core Worlds, Abregado-rae was fairly backward, to the point of being compared with worlds in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The planet's [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] seemed safe, at least to the untrained eye, but in fact it was a known [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler's]] paradise.

The planet had many popular establishments including the [[LoBue Cantina]], [[Lost Loves Casino]], [[Njinska's Tavern]], [[Starlight Theater]], ''[[The Star of Chance]]'', and the [[Triple Nova Casino]]. These were located in either [[Abregado-rae Spaceport]] or [[Le Yer]], both of which attracted visitors from all parts of the galaxy (including [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] on occasions). The city of [[Le Yer]] was a popular coastal resort, with its extension, [[Phyrstal Island]] accessible by [[hydrobike]]s or [[Gados Floatboat|floatboats]].

Abregado-rae was also one of the few planets where the rare metal [[Electrum/Legends|electrum]] was found. It was known to occasionally bubble to the surface in the [[Gilt Gushers]]. This mineral could be used for crafting [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] with many unique qualities; [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] both possessed lightsabers containing electrum.

==History==
The planet was first discovered by scouts from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] around [[10,000 BBY]], during the exploration of hyperlanes that would become the Rimma Trade Route, though colonization would not occur for millennia.<ref name="TEA" /> At the rise of the the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith empire]] under the leadership of [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]], Abregado joined with the Sith, sending their colonists to war against the Republic and [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]]. With the assassination of [[Darth Malak]] and Revan's disappearance, the Empire crumbled and the planet realigned with the Republic.<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was shot down upon having attempted to escape. The vessel consequently dropped off its loot over the southern hemisphere.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|It's Raining Treasure}}</ref> Around the same time, a local auction house misclassified its trinkets and accidentally offered the objects for a far too cheap price.<ref name="GoingOnce">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Going Once...}}</ref>
Furthermore, the canals of [[Abregado-rae Spaceport|Abregado-rae's capital city]] were temporarily drained. The detritus of the canals told the story of the city's history.<ref name="Washed">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology |Washed}}</ref>

Before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a number of residents of Abregado-rae, along with other natives on the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] joined the [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]]. This organization was against corporate monopoly and decadent government, but was dissolved when its leaders were killed or arrested by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].

During the Clone Wars, Abregado-rae was the origin of the [[Shapani Bypass/Legends|Shapani Bypass]], a shortcut along the Rimma Trade Route that was used to quicken the delivery of [[Bacta/Legends|Bacta]] from [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]] to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. While in the first year of the war, a [[Battle of Abregado/Legends|battle]] took place in the [[Abregado system/Legends|Abregado system]]. At the end of the war, with the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the planet quickly joined to ensure security and peace in the system.<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:AbregadoRaeLocals.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The people of Abregado-rae assisting the Alliance]]
The planet eventually saw the founding of the [[Tundei Tribunal]], led by the [[Tundei]] and a [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] named [[Shelov]] who along with other off-worlders, promised a planet without crime. They installed harsh limits on freedom and stopped all legal shipments of food to [[Gado Hill Clans|clans]] in the mountains in an attempt to stifle opposition. This caused it to be a common [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] destination for foodstuffs. The regime eventually made the cost of running illegal operations on the planet so costly, that all illegal investment in Abregado-rae swiftly pulled out, nearly destroying the economy.

The Tribunal also allowed virtually the entire [[Moocher]] population to be destroyed when a potential outbreak of [[Veizen fever]], a disease which drove Moochers mad, was thought capable of spreading to the resident [[Gados]]. During the [[Ssi-ruuvi invasions]], the planet was absorbed into [[Zero Command]]'s territory.<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:AbregadoHTTE4.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The planet surface during the Thrawn campaign]]
During [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] campaign against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], he captured space near Abregado-rae as a possible prelude to a pincer movement on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. This put Abregado-rae on the New Republic side of the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]]. The planet served as a meeting point for Han Solo, Lando Calrissian, and [[Fynn Torve]] (a member of [[Talon Karrde]]'s smuggling organization). [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] later sent the [[Adamant (Victory-class)|''Adamant'']] to Abregado-rae in an attempt to capture some of Karrde's smugglers. The warship managed to intercept and capture [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] and took her to Thrawn.

While New Republic forces were moving through the system as of [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the planet was attacked by the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] at some point before [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]].<ref name="UniForce">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref> As of [[137 ABY]] the world was controlled by [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] and ''[[Star Wars: Rebellion: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'' mistakenly place Abregado-rae in the [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. Both also refer to the planet simply as "Abregado."
